title: Associativity of the specified derived reduction normalizations
statement: Let W be a scheme, R,S,T,V sheaves of commutative rings on its pro-etale site, and let a : R → S, b : S → T, c : T → V, ab : R → T, bc : S → V and abc : R → V satisfy a followed by b = ab, b followed by c = bc, ab followed by c = abc and a followed by bc = abc. For every K in DerivedCategory (pbcModules W R), derived extension along c of pbcReductionNormalization(a,b,ab) at K, followed by pbcReductionNormalization(ab,c,abc) at K, equals pbcReductionNormalization(b,c,bc) at derived extension along a of K, followed by pbcReductionNormalization(a,bc,abc) at K. This is an equality of the specific hom components of the prescribed normalizations.

source.place: Remark 6.8.15, pp. 61–62; the completion-unit and scalar associativity calculation in the parent node, step 6 or 7.

proof.text: The restriction comparisons are the identity on sections, hence satisfy their cocycle. Functor.mapDerivedCategoryCompNatIso_cocycle transports it to the derived comparisons. Identify each prescribed reduction normalization with the left-adjoint composition comparison for the derived restriction isomorphism. Apply Mathlib Adjunction.leftAdjointCompIso_assoc and evaluate its hom component at K.

lean.statement:
theorem rationalMixedReductionNormalizationAssoc {W : Scheme.{u}}
    {R S T V : Sheaf (ProEt.topology W) CommRingCat.{u + 1}}
    (a : R ⟶ S) (b : S ⟶ T) (c : T ⟶ V)
    (ab : R ⟶ T) (bc : S ⟶ V) (abc : R ⟶ V)
    (hab : a ≫ b = ab) (hbc : b ≫ c = bc)
    (hl : ab ≫ c = abc) (hr : a ≫ bc = abc)
    (K : DerivedCategory (pbcModules W R)) :
    (pbcDerivedExtend c).map ((pbcReductionNormalization a b ab hab K).hom) ≫
        (pbcReductionNormalization ab c abc hl K).hom =
      (pbcReductionNormalization b c bc hbc ((pbcDerivedExtend a).obj K)).hom ≫
        (pbcReductionNormalization a bc abc hr K).hom
